report:
**Sample adequacy**
132 white cells across 147 fields (15 fields without white cell) — enough for differential (≥100). 1,341 red cells and 71 platelets detected.

**Differential (indicative adult ranges prevail)**
Overall pattern is unusual: 6/7 types outside indicative ranges — check slide quality and field selection before using differential.
- Basophil 20.5% (27/132) — above 0–2%
- Eosinophil 15.2% (20/132) — above 1–6%
- Monocyte 25.0% (33/132) — above 2–10%
- IG 1.5% (2/132) — above 0–1%
- Neutrophil 19.7% (26/132) — below 40–75%
- Lymphocyte 18.2% (24/132) — below 20–45%

**Review list**
15 cells marked for review (3 with confidence <0.70). Flagged for opening first (9):
- High priority: IG 84 (0.77) and 42 (0.90) — rare type + second-opinion disagreement; monocytes 40 (0.58) and 86 (0.65) — low confidence + disagreement.
- Normal priority: monocyte 23 (0.43), neutrophils 100 (0.86) and 58 (0.88), lymphocytes 19 (0.92) and 6 (0.94) — classifier uncertain or disagreement; all need human morphology check. Counts unchanged; disagreements are for attention only.

**Limits**
Second-opinion model is generalist (65% on single cells, weak on IG/erythroblasts) vs classifier 97.6% (exp.05); red cells undercounted on crowded fields (exp.14) — indicative only.

known_limits: The second opinion model is a generalist: 65 % right on single PBC cells, weak on ig and erythroblasts (experiment 01). The classifier is 97.6 % right on the same data (experiment 05).
Red cells are undercounted on crowded fields (experiment 14); the red cell count is indicative.
Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; the lab's own ranges prevail.

second_opinions.reasoning:
The central cell shows a round, hyperchromatic condensed nucleus with coarse chromatin and a narrow intensely basophilic cytoplasmic rim without granules or segmentation, most consistent with a basophilic erythroblast rather than a mature lymphocyte.
LABEL: erythroblast

The central cell shows a segmented/bilobed dark nucleus with condensed chromatin and pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules surrounded by mature erythrocytes.
LABEL: neutrophil

Large cell with abundant blue-gray vacuolated cytoplasm and an oval slightly indented nucleus lacking specific granules is characteristic of a monocyte.
LABEL: monocyte

Central nucleated cell shows high N:C ratio with a dense dark chromatin mass and scant pale basophilic non-granular cytoplasm without segmentation, consistent with a lymphocyte.
LABEL: lymphocyte

The central object shows an irregular aggregate of basophilic granular cytoplasm without a well-defined WBC nuclear pattern, most consistent with a platelet clump overlying debris.

LABEL: platelet

Large cell with an indented bilobed nucleus showing moderately condensed chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm lacking large specific granules is consistent with a monocyte.
LABEL: monocyte

The central cell shows a bilobed segmented nucleus with coarse reddish-orange specific granules filling pale cytoplasm consistent with a mature eosinophilic granulocyte.
LABEL: eosinophil

Large cell with indented kidney-shaped nucleus, lacy chromatin and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm without specific granules consistent with monocyte.
LABEL: monocyte

The central nucleated cell has abundant deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm with an eccentric irregular condensed nucleus without specific neutrophilic/eosinophilic granules. 
LABEL: lymphocyte

The large cell shows abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a folded/bilobed nucleus with open chromatin without neutrophilic/eosinophilic granules or dense lymphoid clumping.

LABEL: monocyte

Large WBC ~2-3x RBC size with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and a folded/lobated dark nucleus without specific eosinophilic/basophilic granules consistent with monocytic morphology.
LABEL: monocyte

The central cell shows a hyperchromatic round pyknotic nucleus with coarsely condensed chromatin and a thin rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm without neutrophilic/eosinophilic/basophilic granules or segmentation, most consistent with a nucleated erythroid precursor mimicking a small lymphocyte.

LABEL: erythroblast
